fullTextZH: 这个圆圆的东西是什么？

fullTextEN: Oh, I need to go over.
Oh dear, oh dear, it's so hard.
I've gotten a bit fat recently.
Hmm, this chair isn't very comfortable.
Sleep for a while, sleep for a while.
Hello everyone, I am a panda.
Today I will introduce to you,
introduce the characteristics of us pandas.
99% of the time we eat bamboo.

fullTextZH: 现在你们可以看到我在吃饭。
fullTextEN: Now you can see me eating.

fullTextZH: 嗯，现在我觉得吃竹子挺好的。
fullTextEN: Hmm, now I think eating bamboo is quite good.

fullTextZH: 我每天要吃很长时间的竹子。
fullTextEN: I need to eat bamboo for a long time every day.

fullTextZH: 最多的时候，我要吃16个小时。
fullTextEN: At most, I need to eat for 16 hours.

fullTextZH: 现在你们看到我吃的是竹笋。
fullTextEN: Now you see me eating bamboo shoots.
Bamboo shoots are tastier and more tender.

fullTextZH: 中国人也很喜欢吃竹笋。
fullTextEN: Chinese people also like to eat bamboo shoots.

fullTextZH: 你们知道我每天要吃多少食物吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know how much food I need to eat every day?

fullTextZH: 我每天差不多要吃12公斤的食物，
fullTextEN: I need to eat about 12 kilograms of food every day,
I eat so much every day,

fullTextZH: 是不是要拉很多很多屎？
fullTextEN: do I have to poop a lot?

fullTextZH: 我每天拉屎要拉40次左右。
fullTextEN: I need to poop about 40 times a day.

fullTextZH: 因为竹子没有很多营养。
fullTextEN: Because bamboo doesn't have much nutrition.
Sigh, so I eat a lot,
but I also poop a lot.

fullTextZH: 我睡觉的时候也拉屎，嘿嘿。
fullTextEN: I poop even when I sleep, hehe.

fullTextZH: 我出生的时候是粉红色的。
fullTextEN: I was pink when I was born.

fullTextZH: 还有，我出生的时候我是看不到的。
fullTextEN: Also, I was blind when I was born.

fullTextZH: 然后我的颜色也会变成黑白色的。
fullTextEN: Then my color also turns black and white.

fullTextZH: 那为什么我是黑白色的呢？
fullTextEN: So why am I black and white?

fullTextZH: 因为如果别的动物在很远的地方，
fullTextEN: Because if other animals are far away,

fullTextZH: 所以呢，它们就不会来攻击我，来打我，
fullTextEN: So, they won't come to attack me or hit me,
Hehe, I can be very safe.

fullTextZH: 所以黑白色的毛可以保护我。
fullTextEN: So black and white fur can protect me.

fullTextZH: 我知道你们觉得我胖胖的，
fullTextEN: I know you think I'm chubby,
Maybe I'm not very good at sports.

fullTextZH: 最高的时候，我可以爬3.9公里。
fullTextEN: At the highest point, I can climb 3.9 kilometers.

fullTextZH: 有的时候我喜欢挂在树上睡觉。
fullTextEN: Sometimes I like to hang on trees to sleep.

fullTextZH: 嘘，我再告诉你一个秘密：
fullTextEN: Shh, let me tell you a secret:

fullTextZH: 有的时候我也会在树上尿尿，嘿嘿。
fullTextEN: Sometimes I also pee on trees, hehe.

fullTextZH: 我的眼睛和猫的眼睛很像哦。
fullTextEN: My eyes are very similar to a cat's eyes.
Our eyes are all very good.
If it's in a very dark place,

fullTextZH: 最后，欢迎大家来四川看我。
fullTextEN: Finally, welcome everyone to come to Sichuan to see me.

fullTextZH: 如果你们不喜欢去人很多、
fullTextEN: If you don't like going to crowded places,
This is the Dujiangyan Panda Base.

fullTextZH: 也可以看到其他的动物，
啊，可以看到黑色的熊和红色的熊。
fullTextEN: Ah, you can see black bears and red bears.

fullTextZH: 什么？你们觉得他们有一点无聊，
fullTextEN: What? You think they are a bit boring,
and only want to see me?
